evidence.legacy_policy: Read-only compatibility requires checksum_algo=0, the historical CRC32-rotation digest, and unpadded framing. Canonical and legacy fields may not be mixed.
evidence.store_round_trip: A parent RvfStore and branched child were closed; the child reopened, reconstructed byte-equal COW_MAP and MEMBERSHIP state, rediscovered its parent by file identity, and queried inherited data.
evidence.manifest_integration: COW_MAP and MEMBERSHIP segments are directory-linked and guarded by manifest generations; superseded generations remain listed.
evidence.cli_integration: filter uses append_membership_filter; rebuild-refcounts reads cow_stats and appends a manifest-linked canonical REFCOUNT segment.
